remaining_lost_cases.proof_motif: repeated-anchor collapse via expansion, tail collapse, and final congrArg
right-anchored expansion through double x tail
broad projection/extension with extra free variable

seed-collapse / short hand motifs.description: Compact public hand certificates that use one or two h expansions, a local collapse/replacement, and one congrArg/calc closure.
seed-collapse / short hand motifs.structural_guard: Require direct h seed expansion from goal lhs to a midpoint, exact one-hole context extraction from midpoint to goal rhs, and a local edge provable by a symmetric h collapse or self-square replacement. Use no eq-id guard.
seed-collapse / short hand motifs.expected_certificate_size: ~0.5-3 KB per hit; source exact certificates are 420-867 bytes.
seed-collapse / short hand motifs.judge_error_risk: low if route is limited to exact seed/context/collapse shapes and judge-tested before emission.
seed-collapse / short hand motifs.private_value: high: compact motifs are likely to recur and do not depend on large ATP chains.

context-shift / local-theory movement.description: Cases where a direct seed exists, but closure needs a small local movement/rotation or two-local-edge bridge rather than plain argument erasure.
context-shift / local-theory movement.structural_guard: Require shared outer context or direct h seed midpoint, high subterm overlap, and a two-edge calc where both local edges are direct h/symm/congrArg over exact extracted contexts.
context-shift / local-theory movement.expected_certificate_size: ~3-8 KB for compact cases; source certs range 3.2-7.4 KB except some can expand if not alias-normalized.
context-shift / local-theory movement.judge_error_risk: medium: more moving parts and context-shift matching can over-trigger unless exact-context gated.
context-shift / local-theory movement.private_value: medium-high: several remaining cases are in this family and exact certs are moderate.

square-anchor / anchored erasure.description: Hypotheses expose self-square or right-anchor terms and goals require idempotence, absorption, extension, or anchored erasure before a context lift.
square-anchor / anchored erasure.structural_guard: Require x◇x or (_◇x)◇x in the goal/extracted inner edge, repeated anchor in hypothesis, and derivable local idempotence/absorption before emitting anchored erasure.
square-anchor / anchored erasure.expected_certificate_size: ~7-12 KB if using local-theory packages; source certs range 7.3-11.8 KB.
square-anchor / anchored erasure.judge_error_risk: medium-high: local-theory normalizers can overgeneralize and grow certificates.
square-anchor / anchored erasure.private_value: medium: likely useful, but implementation has more safety surface than hand motifs.

tail-shift corridor.description: Repeated y/tail blocks must be shifted through a corridor with nested congrArg and symmetric h collapse.
tail-shift corridor.structural_guard: Require repeated-tail term appearing in both hypothesis and goal, one shiftTail h instance, at most two nested congrArg lifts, and one symmetric h collapse.
tail-shift corridor.expected_certificate_size: ~10-18 KB from public cert precedents; risk of term expansion without alias normalization.
tail-shift corridor.judge_error_risk: medium-high: shape-sensitive and can emit bulky Lean.
tail-shift corridor.private_value: medium: recurring but narrower than seed-collapse and harder to keep compact.

large ATP exact certificate only.description: Cases with known accepted ATP certificates but large/idiosyncratic equality chains that do not isolate into a small reusable motif yet.
large ATP exact certificate only.structural_guard: Defer generalized route. If revisited, require an independent proof-mined motif with size estimate below route cap.
candidate_local_lemmas: unknown or too broad from current data
large ATP exact certificate only.expected_certificate_size: ~32-34 KB for existing exact certificates; generalized proof may remain large.
large ATP exact certificate only.judge_error_risk: high for generalization; low only as exact memo, which is already present in normal mode.
large ATP exact certificate only.private_value: low-medium until a shorter motif is found.

unclear.description: No remaining case is completely unclassified after current reports.

recommendation.reason: This family has the smallest accepted public exact certificates, clear exact-context proof shapes, and the lowest judge-error risk. It can likely recover one or more public exact dependencies with compact route-specific Lean rather than embedding large ATP chains.
